scope: Beads to GitHub mirror, stage M3.2 (bead cr-k88k.3.2): skill guidance for each project state (not opted in, opted in but not the writer, writer clone). tracker acts on digest rows and runs outbound after closing or seeding; pr references the bead or nearest ancestor issue, Refs unless the pull request completes the bead, the writer-clone stop line; triage handles untracked issues and pull requests through link and dismiss; Babysit and Shipping close the bead through tracker after reading a merge back. No report and no upstream trait rows.
method: Spec docs/specs/2026-11-20-beads-github-mirror.md (Project states, Triggers, Packaging skill guidance, Constraints) mapped state by state to one instruction per skill; state detection probed against the command with and without a switch.
carried_debts: The new mirror mechanisms in tracker, pr and triage carry no trait yet: defining them needs trait-definitions.yaml and trait-sharing.yaml, outside this stage.

subject: ours:tracker
why: Mirror stage M3.2: a GitHub mirror branch and section. It tells the three project states apart (the command map prints or fails only with the writer switch; the committed reference-check workflow marks opted in), closes a bead on merge evidence (a merge Babysit or Shipping read back, or a digest row) only when acceptance, reviews and owner decisions allow and otherwise comments and leaves it open, runs outbound after closing or seeding in the writer clone, says in one line that outbound is skipped in an opted-in non-writer clone, and routes the other digest rows to triage or the owner. Traits unchanged (carried debt in the round header); tree hash refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.

subject: ours:pr
why: Mirror stage M3.2: an issue reference line and its section. In an opted-in project the body references the bead own issue, else the nearest ancestor issue; with none, the writer clone runs the command pr path (outbound --bead) and any other clone stops with ask the writer clone to mirror this bead; Closes only when the pull request completes the bead that owns the issue, Refs otherwise, an ancestor issue included. Not opted in: no reference line. Traits unchanged (carried debt in the round header); tree hash refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.

subject: ours:triage
why: Mirror stage M3.2: a fifth attention bucket and a section for the digest untracked issues and pull requests. In the writer clone: track it (a bead, then the command link subcommand for a tracking-only link), dismiss, or comment or close on GitHub only with the owner authorization; in an opted-in non-writer clone, links go through the ordinary Beads workflow and dismiss is left to the writer; not opted in, the section does not apply. Traits unchanged (carried debt in the round header); tree hash refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.

subject: ours:tracker
why: Mirror stage M3.2, corrects :010. As :010, with critic fixes: opted in is read from the committed tree (git cat-file -e HEAD:.github/workflows/bead-reference-check.yml), so a staged add or delete does not change the state; for a merge Babysit or Shipping hands over, outbound runs only for each bead the step closed (outbound --bead), never the full run, and a bead left open runs nothing; after a failed writer run, beads it did not publish still need a foreground outbound because the background run creates none.
